comment: REDDHI introduces a fifth term alongside DPI, foundational DPI, DPI-H and the reference architecture, for what the text then describes as a condition of maturity rather than a thing. Readers are likely to treat it as a further category of system to procure, which the section explicitly says it is not. The acronym also does not translate well.

anchor.note: p.27 l.109 read as the printed page; section 2.2.1 agrees

public.text: REDDHI introduces a fifth term alongside DPI, foundational DPI, DPI-H and the reference architecture, for what the text then describes as a condition of maturity rather than a thing. Readers are likely to treat it as a further category of system to procure, which the section explicitly says it is not. The acronym also does not translate well.
public.suggestedRevision: State in the first sentence that REDDHI names a state of the system and not a set of components, and give the relationship to DPI-H in one line - DPI-H is what is built, REDDHI is the condition its maturity produces. Alternatively dispense with the acronym and use a descriptive phrase. If retained, add it to the terminology table in the front matter with that distinction stated.
